text_es: Create a page with a single 'card' div. Inside the card, have an 'h2' with text 'Card Title' and a 'p' with text 'This is the card content.'. The card should have a background color of #F0F0F0, a padding of 15px, and a border-radius of 8px. The h2 should be #333333 and the p should be #666666.

Design an 'alert' div containing a 'span' for an icon (e.g., '⚠') and a 'p' for the message 'Warning: Something went wrong.'. The alert box should have a background of #FFF3CD, a border of 1px solid #FFECB3, padding of 10px, and text color #856404. The span should be bold.

Create a 'nav' element with a 'ul' inside. The ul should contain three 'li' elements, each with an 'a' link ('Home', 'About', 'Contact'). The nav should have a background of #333333. The li elements should display inline, and the a links should be #FFFFFF, have no underline, and 10px padding.

Add a 'button' element with the text 'Click Me'. The button should have a background of #007BFF, text color #FFFFFF, padding of 10px 20px, a border-radius of 5px, and no border. On hover, the background should change to #0056b3.

Create a 'profile-header' div. Inside, include an 'img' (e.g., placeholder.png) with class 'profile-pic' and an 'h1' with text 'John Doe'. The profile-header should be centered with a max-width of 300px. The image should be a circle (border-radius 50%) with a 2px solid #DDDDDD border. The h1 should be #333333 and centered.

Design a 'pricing-item' div. Inside, include an 'h3' (Plan Name), a 'p' (Price: $10/month), and a 'button' (Buy Now). The pricing-item should have a border of 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding of 20px, and text-align center. The h3 should be #007BFF. The button should be similar to t004 but with a background of #28A745.

Create a 'gallery-item' div. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., gallery.jpg) and a 'p' (Image Caption). The gallery-item should have a border of 1px solid #CCCCCC and a padding of 5px. The image should be 100% width of its parent. The caption should be #555555 and font-size 0.9em.

Create a 'div' with class 'form-group'. Inside, a 'label' (Email:) and an 'input' of type text. The label should be #333333. The input should have a 1px solid #CCCCCC border, 8px padding, and a border-radius of 4px. On focus, the border should change to #007BFF.

Style an 'ol' with three 'li' items (Item 1, Item 2, Item 3). The list items should have a bottom border of 1px dotted #BBBBBB. The text color should be #444444. The list markers should be colored #007BFF.

Create a 'blockquote' with a 'p' (This is a profound quote.) and a 'footer' (— Author Name). The blockquote should have a left border of 5px solid #AAAAAA, padding of 15px, and font-style italic. The footer should be #777777 and text-align right.

Design a 'feature-box' div. Inside, an 'h3' (Awesome Feature) and a 'p' (Short description of the feature.). The feature-box should have a background of #E9F5FF, padding of 20px, and a subtle box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1). The h3 should be #0056b3.

Create a 'cta-section' div. It contains an 'h2' (Ready to Start?) and a 'button' (Get Started Now!). The cta-section should have a background of #6C757D, padding of 30px, and text-align center. The h2 should be #FFFFFF. The button should have a background #28A745 and text #FFFFFF.

Design a 'product-item' div. Inside, an 'img' (product.jpg), an 'h4' (Product Name), and a 'span' (Price: $29.99). The product-item should have a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 10px, and text-align center. The image should be 150px wide. The span should be bold and #DC3545.

Create a 'team-member' div. Inside, an 'img' (member.jpg), an 'h3' (Jane Doe), and a 'p' (Role/Title). The team-member should have a background of #FFFFFF, border-radius 10px, box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), and text-align center. The image should be 120px circular. The h3 should be #333333.

Design a 'footer' element. Inside, a 'p' (© 2023 My Website) and a 'ul' with two 'li' items (Privacy, Terms). The footer should have a background of #343A40, padding of 20px, and text-align center. The p should be #AAAAAA. The ul li should display inline and the text color should be #AAAAAA with 15px margin-right.

Create a 'testimonial' div. Inside, a 'p' (This product is amazing!) and a 'span' (— Customer Name). The testimonial should have a background of #F8F9FA, padding of 20px, and border-left 4px solid #007BFF. The p should be italic. The span should be #666666 and text-align right.

Design a 'status-box' div. Inside, a 'span' with class 'status-icon' (e.g., '✓') and a 'p' (Status: Active). The status-box should have a border of 1px solid #28A745 and a background of #D4EDDA. The status-icon should be #28A745 and font-weight bold. The p should be #155724.

Create an 'article-header' div. Inside, an 'h1' (Article Title) and a 'p' (Published on: Jan 1, 2023). The article-header should have a bottom border of 1px solid #EEEEEE and padding-bottom 15px. The h1 should be #333333 and font-size 2.5em. The p should be #777777 and font-size 0.9em.

Create a 'div' with class 'list-item'. Inside, a 'span' (Item Name) and a 'button' (Edit). The list-item should have a border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 10px, and display flex with space-between. The button should have a background #FFC107, text #333333, and no border.

Design a 'hero-section' div. Inside, an 'h1' (Welcome to Our Site) and a 'p' (Your journey starts here.). The hero-section should have a background-image (e.g., url(hero-bg.jpg)), a background-size cover, min-height 300px, text-align center, and text color #FFFFFF. The h1 should be font-size 3em.

Create a 'div' with id 'progress-container'. Inside, a 'div' with id 'progress-bar'. The container should have a background #E0E0E0 and a height of 20px, border-radius 10px. The progress-bar should have a background #007BFF, a height of 100%, and a width of 50% (example value), also border-radius 10px.

Design a 'div' with class 'toggle-switch'. Inside, a 'label' and an 'input' of type checkbox. The toggle-switch should have a specific width (e.g., 60px) and height (e.g., 34px). The label should visually represent the switch, with a background of #CCCCCC when unchecked, and #2196F3 when checked. Use pseudo-elements for the 'thumb'.

Create a 'div' with class 'dropdown-item'. Inside, an 'a' link (Menu Link). The dropdown-item should have padding 10px 15px. The 'a' should be #333333 and have no underline. On hover, the dropdown-item's background should change to #F8F9FA and the text color to #007BFF.
Design a 'span' with class 'tag'. It contains text 'New Feature'. The tag should have a background of #17A2B8, text color #FFFFFF, padding 5px 10px, and a border-radius of 15px. Font-size 0.8em.

Create a 'comment-block' div. Inside, an 'h4' (User Name) and a 'p' (This is a comment.). The comment-block should have a background of #F8F8F8, border of 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and border-radius 5px. The h4 should be #007BFF.

Create a 'nav' with class 'breadcrumb'. Inside, a 'ul' with three 'li' items (Home, Category, Current Page), each containing an 'a' link. The li elements should display inline with a '»' separator (using pseudo-elements). The 'a' links should be #007BFF, with the last li's 'a' being #6C757D and no link decoration.

Design an 'a' element with class 'page-link' and text '1'. It should have a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 8px 12px, text color #007BFF, and no underline. On hover, the background should be #F8F9FA. For an active page, the background should be #007BFF and text color #FFFFFF.

Create a 'div' with class 'spinner'. This div should be a circle (e.g., 50px width/height, border-radius 50%) with a 4px solid #F3F3F3 border and a 4px solid #007BFF top border. Animate it to spin indefinitely.

Design a 'div' with class 'modal-header'. Inside, an 'h3' (Modal Title) and a 'button' (x). The modal-header should have a background of #F8F9FA, padding 15px, and a bottom border of 1px solid #EEEEEE. It should display flex with space-between. The button should have no background/border, font-size 1.5em, and text #AAAAAA.

Create a 'div' with id 'cookie-banner'. Inside, a 'p' (We use cookies...) and a 'button' (Accept). The banner should be fixed at the bottom of the viewport, have a background #333333, text color #FFFFFF, padding 15px, and display flex with align-items center. The button should be #28A745.

Design a 'div' with class 'image-container'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., scenic.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'overlay' containing a 'p' (Beautiful View). The image-container should be positioned relative. The overlay should be positioned absolute, cover the image entirely, have a semi-transparent black background (rgba(0,0,0,0.6)), and center the text #FFFFFF. Initially, the overlay should be hidden and appear on hover.

Create a 'div' with class 'avatar-wrapper'. Inside, an 'img' (user.jpg) and a 'span' with class 'status-dot'. The image should be 50px circular. The status-dot should be positioned absolute (e.g., bottom-right of avatar), a small green circle (10px, background #28A745, border-radius 50%), and border 2px solid #FFFFFF.

Design a 'pre' element with a 'code' element inside. The code element contains a few lines of code. The pre should have a background of #F8F8F8, border of 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, border-radius 5px, and font-family monospace. The text color should be #333333.

Style a 'table' with a 'thead' containing 'th' (Header 1, Header 2) and a 'tbody' containing two 'tr' with 'td' (Data 1, Data 2). The table should have a 1px solid #CCCCCC border. The th elements should have a background #F8F8F8 and padding 10px. The td elements should have padding 8px. Alternate rows (tbody tr:nth-child(even)) should have a background #F0F0F0.

Create a 'div' with class 'chat-bubble incoming'. Inside, a 'p' (Hello there!). The chat-bubble should have a background of #E2E2E2, padding 10px 15px, border-radius 15px 15px 15px 0, max-width 70%, and align to the left. The text color should be #333333.

Create a 'div' with class 'chat-bubble outgoing'. Inside, a 'p' (I'm good, thanks!). The chat-bubble should have a background of #007BFF, padding 10px 15px, border-radius 15px 15px 0 15px, max-width 70%, and align to the right using margin-left auto. The text color should be #FFFFFF.

Design a 'span' with class 'kbd'. It contains text 'Ctrl + C'. The kbd element should have a background of #EEEEEE, border of 1px solid #BBBBBB, padding 3px 6px, border-radius 3px, font-family monospace, and font-size 0.9em.

Create a 'div' with class 'video-thumbnail'. Inside, an 'img' (video.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'play-icon' (e.g., '▶'). The thumbnail should be positioned relative. The play-icon should be positioned absolute in the center, a large white triangle on a semi-transparent black circle, and font-size 2em.

Create a 'div' with class 'icon-wrapper'. Inside, an 'i' (e.g., a bell icon) and a 'span' with class 'notification-dot'. The icon-wrapper should be positioned relative. The notification-dot should be positioned absolute (e.g., top-right of icon), a small red circle (8px, background #DC3545, border-radius 50%), and display block.

Design a 'div' with class 'accordion-header'. Inside, an 'h4' (Section Title) and a 'span' (▼). The header should have a background of #F8F9FA, border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and display flex with space-between and align-items center. The span should be #666666.

Create a 'div' with class 'separator'. Inside, a 'span' (OR). The separator should have a top and bottom border (1px solid #DDDDDD). The span should be positioned absolute, have a background of #FFFFFF, padding 0 10px, and text color #777777, effectively 'cutting' the line.

Design a 'div' with class 'empty-state'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., empty-folder.png) and a 'p' (No items found.). The empty-state should be text-align center, have a padding of 30px, and a border of 1px dashed #CCCCCC. The image should be 80px wide. The p should be #666666.

Create a 'ul' with class 'checkmark-list'. It contains three 'li' items (Feature 1, Feature 2, Feature 3). Each li should have a checkmark icon (e.g., '✓') as a pseudo-element before the text. The checkmark should be green (#28A745) and the text black (#333333).

Design a 'div' with class 'rating'. It contains five 'span' elements, each with a star character (★). The stars should be gold (#FFC107) for the first three, and grey (#DDDDDD) for the remaining two (representing a 3-star rating).

Create a 'button' with id 'scroll-top'. It contains an arrow icon (▲). The button should be fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport, have a background #007BFF, text #FFFFFF, border-radius 50%, 50px width/height, and a box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2). Initially hidden, appears on scroll.

Design an 'a' element with class 'segment-item' and text 'Option 1'. It should have a border of 1px solid #007BFF, padding 8px 15px, text color #007BFF, and border-radius (e.g., for left/right ends of a group). For an active item, the background should be #007BFF and text #FFFFFF.

Create a 'div' with class 'dropzone'. Inside, a 'p' (Drag & drop files here or click to upload). The dropzone should have a border of 2px dashed #007BFF, background #F0F8FF, padding 30px, text-align center, and text color #007BFF. On hover, the border should become solid.

Design a 'div' with class 'skill-bar-container'. Inside, a 'div' with class 'skill-bar-fill'. The container should have a background #E0E0E0, height 15px, and border-radius 8px. The fill should have a background #28A745, height 100%, and a width of 75% (example value), also border-radius 8px.

Create a 'ul' with class 'ingredients'. It contains three 'li' items (1 cup flour, 2 eggs, 1/2 tsp salt). Each li should have a bullet point, padding 5px, and a bottom border of 1px dotted #DDDDDD. Text color should be #444444.

Design an 'a' element with class 'social-icon' and an 'i' (e.g., a Font Awesome icon class like 'fa fa-facebook'). The link should be a circle (e.g., 40px, border-radius 50%), have a background of #3B5998, text color #FFFFFF, and text-align center with line-height for vertical centering. On hover, the background should darken slightly.

Create an 'event-card' div. Inside, an 'h3' (Event Title), a 'p' with class 'date' (Date: Jan 1, 2024), and a 'p' with class 'location' (Location: City Hall). The event-card should have a background of #FFFFFF, border 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and border-radius 8px. The date should be bold and #007BFF. The location should be #6C757D.

Design a 'div' with class 'input-group'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'addon' (e.g., '@') and an 'input' of type text. The input-group should display flex. The addon should have a background #E9ECEF, border 1px solid #CED4DA, padding 8px 12px, border-right: none. The input should have a 1px solid #CED4DA border, padding 8px, and border-left: none. Round the corners appropriately for a combined look.

Create a 'div' with class 'timer-digit'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'value' (e.g., '05') and a 'span' with class 'label' (e.g., 'Days'). The timer-digit should have a background #343A40, text-align center, padding 10px, and border-radius 5px. The value should be large (font-size 2.5em) and #FFFFFF. The label should be smaller (font-size 0.8em) and #AAAAAA.

Design a 'div' with class 'scrollable-area'. Inside, a 'p' with 10-15 lines of lorem ipsum text. The scrollable-area should have a fixed height (e.g., 200px), a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 10px, and overflow-y: scroll. The text color should be #333333.

Create a 'div' with class 'highlight-box'. Inside, an 'h3' (Important Note) and a 'p' (This is a highlighted piece of information.). The highlight-box should have a background of #FFF3CD, border-left 5px solid #FFC107, padding 15px, and border-radius 4px. The h3 should be #856404.

Design a 'div' with class 'step'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'step-number' (e.g., '1') and a 'p' (Step Description). The step should have display flex and align-items center. The step-number should be a circle (e.g., 30px, background #007BFF, text #FFFFFF, border-radius 50%, text-align center, line-height 30px) with 10px right margin. The p should be #333333.

Create a 'div' with class 'file-item'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'file-icon' (e.g., '🖹') and a 'a' (document.pdf). The file-item should have padding 8px, border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, and display flex with align-items center. The file-icon should be #6C757D and 10px right margin. The 'a' should be #007BFF with no underline.

Design a 'div' with class 'coupon-box'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'code' (e.g., 'SAVE10') and a 'button' (Copy). The coupon-box should have a border of 2px dashed #28A745, background #D4EDDA, padding 10px, display flex, and justify-content space-between. The code should be bold and #155724. The button should have background #28A745 and text #FFFFFF.

Create a 'ul' with class 'permissions-list'. It contains three 'li' items (Read, Write, Delete). Each li should have a checkbox input before its text. The text color should be #333333 and li padding 5px.

Design a 'div' with class 'grid-item'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., grid-pic.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'title' (Image Title). The grid-item should have a border 1px solid #DDDDDD, overflow hidden, and position relative. The image should be 100% width. The title should be positioned absolute at the bottom, have a background rgba(0,0,0,0.7), padding 5px, text #FFFFFF, and 100% width.

Create a blog post preview. It has a `div` with class `post-preview`. Inside, there's an `h3` with class `post-title`, a `p` with class `post-excerpt`, and a `span` with class `post-date`. The `post-preview` should have a light grey background (#f8f8f8), 15px padding, and a 1px solid light grey border (#e0e0e0). The `post-title` should be bold, 1.2em font size, and color #333. The `post-excerpt` should have font size 0.9em and color #666. The `post-date` should be italic, 0.8em font size, and color #999, aligned to the right.

Design a contact form fieldset. Use a `fieldset` with id `contact-info`. Inside, there's a `legend` and two `div`s, each containing a `label` and an `input` (one for 'Name', one for 'Email'). The `fieldset` should have a 2px dotted border in #ccc and 20px padding. The `legend` should have a background of #eee, 10px padding, and text color #555. `label`s should be bold and display as block. `input` fields should have a 1px solid border #ddd, 8px padding, and a width of 250px.

Style a single product feature item for a grid. It consists of a `div` with class `feature-item`. Inside, there's an `i` (for icon) with class `feature-icon`, an `h4` with class `feature-title`, and a `p` with class `feature-description`. The `feature-item` should have 20px padding, a light blue background (#e9f7fe), and a 1px solid border (#c0e0f9). The `feature-icon` should be 3em, color #007bff, and centered. `feature-title` should be bold, 1.1em, color #333. `feature-description` should be 0.9em, color #666.

Create a dashboard widget header. Use a `div` with class `widget-header`. Inside, there's an `h2` with class `widget-title` and a `span` with class `widget-action-icon`. The `widget-header` should have a dark grey background (#333), white text (#fff), 15px padding, and be flex-aligned to space-between. The `widget-title` should be 1.1em, bold. The `widget-action-icon` should be 0.9em, color #bbb, and have a pointer cursor.

Style a single item in a shopping cart. It's a `div` with class `cart-item`. Inside, there's an `img` with class `item-thumbnail`, a `div` with class `item-details` containing an `h4` (item name) and `span` (item price), and a `button` with class `remove-item`. The `cart-item` should have a white background, 15px padding, and a 1px solid bottom border (#eee). `item-thumbnail` should be 60px by 60px, float left, and have 10px right margin. `item-details` should have `h4` as 1em bold, `span` as 0.9em color #888. `remove-item` button should be small, red (#dc3545) with white text, 5px padding.

Display a list of tags for an article. Use a `div` with class `tag-list`. Inside, there are multiple `span` elements with class `tag`. The `tag-list` should have a small top margin. Each `tag` should have a light blue background (#e0f7fa), dark blue text (#00796b), 8px padding (vertical 4px, horizontal 8px), a 4px border-radius, and display as inline-block with a 5px right margin.

Create a quick statistics display. Use a `div` with class `stat-box`. Inside, there's a `p` with class `stat-value` and another `p` with class `stat-label`. The `stat-box` should have a light background (#f0f8ff), 20px padding, a 1px solid border (#d0e0ff), and be text-aligned center. The `stat-value` should be bold, 2em font size, and color #0056b3. The `stat-label` should be 0.9em font size and color #666.

Style a simple language selector. It's a `div` with class `lang-selector`. Inside, there are multiple `a` tags with class `lang-option`. The `lang-selector` should have a subtle bottom border (#eee) and 5px bottom padding. Each `lang-option` should be grey (#666), 0.9em, have 5px horizontal padding, and a right border of 1px solid #ccc (except the last one). On hover, text color should be #007bff.

Present data as key-value pairs. Use a `div` with class `data-list`. Inside, there are several `div`s, each with class `data-row`. Each `data-row` contains a `span` with class `data-key` and a `span` with class `data-value`. The `data-list` should have 1px solid #eee bottom border. Each `data-row` should have 8px vertical padding. `data-key` should be bold, color #555, and occupy 30% width. `data-value` should be color #333 and occupy 70% width. Both spans should display as inline-block.

Style a single link for a user menu. It's an `a` tag with class `menu-link`. Inside, there's an `i` for an icon and a `span` for the text. The `menu-link` should display as a block, have 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, text color #333, and no underline. The icon should be 1.2em and have 10px right margin. On hover, the background should be light grey (#f0f0f0) and text color #007bff.

Design a single step in a recipe. It's a `li` with class `recipe-step`. Inside, there's a `span` with class `step-number` and a `p` with class `step-description`. The `recipe-step` should have 10px bottom margin and a dotted bottom border (#ddd). The `step-number` should be a circular badge (25px width/height, #007bff background, white text, centered, bold, 50% border-radius). The `step-description` should be 0.95em, color #444, and left-aligned next to the number.

Style a download button that includes an icon. It's an `a` tag with class `download-btn`. Inside, there's an `i` for the icon and a `span` for the text 'Download File'. The `download-btn` should have a green background (#28a745), white text, 12px vertical and 20px horizontal padding, 5px border-radius, no underline, and display inline-flex with items centered. The icon should have 8px right margin. On hover, background should darken to #218838.

Style a 'Reply' link for a comment section. It's an `a` tag with class `reply-link`. It should be small (0.8em), grey text (#6c757d), no underline, and have a small left margin. On hover, text color should be #007bff and underline appears.

Create a success message box. It's a `div` with class `success-message`. Inside, there's an `i` for a checkmark icon and a `p` for the message text. The `success-message` should have a light green background (#d4edda), green border (#28a745), green text (#155724), 15px padding, 5px border-radius, and display as flex with items centered. The icon should have 10px right margin and be 1.2em.

Design a quantity selector. It's a `div` with class `quantity-selector`. Inside, there are two `button`s (one for '-' and one for '+') and an `input` with type 'number' in between. The `quantity-selector` should display as inline-flex. The `button`s should have a light grey background (#eee), 1px solid border (#ccc), 8px padding, and same width/height (e.g., 30px). The `input` should be text-aligned center, 1px solid border (#ccc), 8px padding, and a fixed width (e.g., 40px), no spin buttons.

Style a thumbnail for a related blog post. It's a `div` with class `related-post`. Inside, there's an `img` with class `post-thumb` and an `h5` with class `post-title`. The `related-post` should display as flex. The `post-thumb` should be 60px by 60px, have a small right margin, and 3px border-radius. The `post-title` should be 0.9em, color #333, and limited to two lines (ellipsis for overflow).

Create a search input field with an appended button. It's a `div` with class `search-bar`. Inside, there's an `input` with class `search-input` and a `button` with class `search-btn`. The `search-bar` should display as flex. The `search-input` should have 1px solid border (#ccc), 10px padding, and take up available space. The `search-btn` should have a blue background (#007bff), white text, 10px padding, and no border. Round the corners of the input on the left and button on the right.

Style an item for an avatar group display. It's an `img` with class `avatar-circle`. The `avatar-circle` should be 40px by 40px, have a 50% border-radius, and a 2px solid white border. When stacked, each avatar should overlap the previous one by 10px (using negative margin).

Style a single link within a breadcrumb navigation. It's an `a` tag with class `breadcrumb-item`. It should have grey text (#666), 0.9em font size, no underline. After each item (except the last), add a ' / ' separator with a slightly lighter color (#aaa).

Design a filter chip component. It's a `span` with class `filter-chip`. It should have a light blue background (#e0f7fa), dark blue text (#00796b), 5px vertical and 10px horizontal padding, 15px border-radius, display as inline-flex with items centered, and a small right margin. Add a small 'x' icon (e.g., `×`) that appears on hover, acting as a close button.

Style a line number within a code block. It's a `span` with class `line-number`. It should have a light grey background (#f0f0f0), dark grey text (#999), 5px horizontal padding, fixed width (e.g., 30px), text-align right, and display as inline-block. It should be positioned to the left of the actual code line.

Style a heading for a section in a sidebar menu. It's an `h4` with class `menu-section-heading`. It should be uppercase, 0.8em font size, light grey text (#aaa), bold, and have 15px top and 5px bottom padding.

Create a container for an alert icon. It's a `div` with class `alert-icon-wrapper`. Inside, there's an `i` tag. The `alert-icon-wrapper` should be a circle (e.g., 40px width/height), red background (#dc3545), white text, centered icon, 50% border-radius. The icon (`i`) should be 1.5em.

Style a single day cell in a calendar. It's a `div` with class `calendar-day`. It should have a 1px solid light grey border (#eee), 10px padding, and a minimum height (e.g., 80px). Style an `img` with class `.product-thumb`. It should be 100px by 100px, have a 1px solid light grey border (#ddd), and 4px border-radius. Add a subtle shadow on hover (box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)).

Design a `span` with class `.category-tag`. It should have a light blue background (#cfe2f3), 3px vertical and 8px horizontal padding, 2px border-radius, and dark blue text (#2a6496). Font size 0.8em.

Create a `div` with class `.icon-text-block`. It should contain a `span` (icon) that is 20px by 20px, left-aligned, and an adjacent `span` (text) with 1em font and #333 color. Add 10px spacing between icon and text.

Create a `div` with class `.alert-success`. It should have a light green background (#d4edda), 15px padding, a 1px solid green border (#c3e6cb), 5px border-radius, and dark green text (#155724). Contains a `p` (alert-text).
Style a `span` with class `.price-display`. It should be bold, 1.4em font size, and a prominent blue color (#007bff). Add a dollar sign prefix (e.g., '$' inside a `span.currency`).
Style an `img` with class `.captioned-image`. It should have a 1px solid light grey border (#ddd). Below it, a `p` (image-caption) with 0.9em font, italic, and #666 color, centered horizontally.

Style two `button` elements with class `.cta-btn` inside a `div.btn-group`. The first button should have a blue background (#007bff), white text, 10px padding, 5px border-radius. The second should be outlined (transparent background, blue border, blue text). Add 10px spacing between them.

Create a `div` with class `.profile-field`. It should contain a `span` (field-label) that is bold and has a dark grey color (#333), and an adjacent `span` (field-value) with regular font and #555 color. Add 10px vertical padding and a 1px dashed bottom border (#eee).

Style an `li` with class `.tag-list-item`. It should display a `span` (tag-text) with a light grey background (#f2f2f2), 3px vertical and 8px horizontal padding, 3px border-radius, and dark grey text (#555).

Style an `a` element with class `.page-link`. It should have 8px padding, 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), no text-decoration, and dark grey text (#333). On hover, background should be light grey (#f0f0f0). Active link (`.active`) should have a blue background (#007bff) and white text (#fff).
Style an `h4` with class `.modal-title`. It should be bold, 1.5em font size, dark grey (#343a40), and have 15px vertical padding and a 1px solid light grey bottom border (#dee2e6).
Create a `span` with class `.time-slot`. It should have a light blue background (#e0f7fa), 5px vertical and 10px horizontal padding, 3px border-radius, and dark blue text (#00796b). Font size 0.9em.

Style an `input` with class `.search-input`. It should have 10px padding, 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), and 5px border-radius. Include a `span` (search-icon) element next to it, styled with a grey color (#888) and a suitable icon (e.g. '🔍'). The icon should be visually integrated on the left side of the input field.

Style a `span` with class `.status-dot`. It should be 10px by 10px, circular (border-radius: 50%), with a green background (#28a745) for 'online' status, red (#dc3545) for 'offline' (use modifier class `.offline`), and yellow (#ffc107) for 'away' (`.away`).
Style an `li` within a `ul.simple-list`. Each `li` should have 5px vertical padding and a 1px dotted bottom border (#ddd). Text color #333.
Style a `li` with class `.feature-check`. It should contain a `span` (check-icon) with a green checkmark '✔' and a `span` (feature-text) with #555 color. Add 5px vertical padding.
Create a `div` with class `.author-info`. It contains an `img` (author-avatar) 40px by 40px circular, and a `span` (author-name) bold and #333. Arrange them horizontally with 10px spacing.

Design a `div` with class `.qty-input-group`. It contains an `input` (qty-field) 50px wide, centered text, and two `button`s (qty-btn) for increment/decrement. Buttons should be 25px by 25px, dark grey background (#6c757d), white text, and rounded on the outer edges of the group.
Style a `p` with class `.quote-text` inside a `div.testimonial`. It should be italic, 1.1em font size, and have a dark grey color (#444). Add 15px vertical padding and a 1px dotted top border (#ddd).

Style a `span` with class `.feature-icon`. It should be 24px by 24px, circular, with a light blue background (#e0f2f7) and a dark blue icon (e.g. '⭐' with color #00bcd4) centered within it. Add a right margin of 10px.

Style an `input` with type 'email' and class `.newsletter-input`. It should have 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), and 5px border-radius. On focus, the border should turn light blue (#80bdff).
Style a `textarea` with class `.contact-textarea`. It should have 10px padding, 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), 5px border-radius, and a minimum height of 100px. Resize should be vertical only.
Style a `th` with class `.table-header`. It should have 12px padding, a light grey background (#f8f8f8), 1px solid light grey border (#ddd), and bold, dark grey text (#333). Text should be centered.

Style a `div` with class `.time-slot-item`. It should have 8px vertical and 12px horizontal padding, 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), 4px border-radius, and dark grey text (#333). On hover, background becomes light grey (#f0f0f0). Active state (`.selected`) has a blue background (#007bff) and white text.

Create a `div` with class `.notification-alert`. It should have a light blue background (#e0f7fa), 15px padding, 1px solid light blue border (#b2ebf2), 5px border-radius, and dark blue text (#00796b). Contains a `p` (alert-message) and a `button` (close-btn) for dismissing (X symbol, no background, dark grey text).

Style a `span` with class `.rating-star`. It should display a yellow star '⭐' with a font size of 1.2em. Active stars (`.filled`) should be yellow, inactive ones (`.empty`) should be light grey (#ccc).

Create a `div` with class `.user-status`. It contains a `span` (status-dot) (10px by 10px, green background for online, red for offline, circular), and an adjacent `span` (status-text) with dark grey text (#333) and 0.9em font. Align them horizontally with 5px spacing.

Create a card with a light gray background (#f8f8f8), a subtle border (1px solid #eee), and a small padding (15px). It should contain a heading (.card-title, font-size: 1.2em, color: #333) and a paragraph (.card-body, font-size: 0.9em, color: #666).

Design a primary button (.cta-button) with a solid blue background (#007bff), white text (#fff), 10px vertical and 20px horizontal padding, and slightly rounded corners (border-radius: 5px). Add a hover effect that slightly darkens the background (#0056b3).
Display a product price (.product-price) in a prominent way. Use a large font size (1.5em), bold text, and a primary color (#dc3545) for the price. Include a currency symbol before the number.

Design an error message box (.error-box) with a light red background (#f8d7da), red text (#721c24), a red border (1px solid #f5c6cb), and 15px padding. The text should be slightly smaller (font-size: 0.9em).
Create a small, round user avatar (.user-avatar) with a fixed width and height (40px), a gray border (1px solid #ccc), and a border-radius of 50%. The image inside should fill the circle.
Style a product title (.product-title) with a large font size (2em), bold text, and a dark color (#343a40). Add a small bottom margin (10px).
Create a horizontal rule (.separator) that acts as a visual separator. It should be a thin (1px) solid light gray line (#e9ecef) with 20px top and bottom margin.

Style a basic text input field (.text-input) with a light gray border (1px solid #ced4da), 10px padding, and slightly rounded corners (border-radius: 4px). On focus, the border should turn light blue (#80bdff).
Design a blockquote (.quote-block) with an italic font style, a left border (4px solid #ccc), and 15px padding. Below the quote, add an attribution (.quote-author, font-weight: bold, color: #555).
Create a small, pill-shaped tag (.tag) with a light blue background (#e0f2f7), dark blue text (#007bff), 5px vertical and 10px horizontal padding, and a large border-radius (20px).
Style a warning alert banner (.warning-banner) with a light yellow background (#fff3cd), orange text (#856404), a yellow border (1px solid #ffeeba), and 15px padding. The text should be centered.

Create a small box (.feature-box) for a product feature. It should have a white background, 15px padding, a light gray border (1px solid #eee), and a prominent icon (.feature-icon, font-size: 1.5em, color: #28a745) at the top, followed by a title (.feature-title, font-weight: bold, color: #333).
Style an active navigation link (.nav-link.active) with a blue background (#007bff), white text (#fff), 8px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, and rounded corners (border-radius: 4px).
Style a standard table data cell (.table-cell) with 10px padding, a light gray bottom border (1px solid #dee2e6), and dark text (#212529). Text should be left-aligned.
Design a small information box (.info-box) with a light blue background (#e9f7fe), dark blue text (#0056b3), 12px padding, and a subtle border (1px solid #cce5ff). The text should be centered.

Create a small label (.price-label) for a price point. It should have a green background (#28a745), white text (#fff), small padding (3px vertical, 8px horizontal), and rounded corners (border-radius: 3px).

Design a product image thumbnail (.product-thumb) with a fixed width and height (100px), a light gray border (1px solid #ddd), and a small margin (5px). The image should be centered within the thumbnail.

Style a 'Read More' link (.read-more-link) with a primary blue color (#007bff), no underline, and a small right arrow icon (e.g., '→') to the right of the text. On hover, the link should be underlined.

Create a small circular status indicator (.status-dot) with a fixed size (10px by 10px) and a border-radius of 50%. It should have a green background for 'online' (#28a745) and a gray background for 'offline' (#6c757d).
Style a card header title (.card-header-title) with a bold font (font-weight: bold), dark gray text (#343a40), and a 15px bottom margin. The font size should be 1.1em.

Create a simple, rectangular badge (.badge) with a light gray background (#e9ecef), dark gray text (#6c757d), 4px vertical and 8px horizontal padding, and slightly rounded corners (border-radius: 3px).
Design a modal close button (.modal-close-btn) as a simple 'X' character. It should be dark gray (#6c757d), have no background or border, and turn red (#dc3545) on hover. Font size should be 1.5em.
Style a small card footer (.card-footer) with a light gray background (#f8f9fa), a top border (1px solid #e9ecef), and 10px padding. Text inside should be smaller (0.8em) and light gray (#6c757d).
Design a small input for quantity selection (.qty-input). It should have a fixed width (50px), a light gray border (1px solid #ccc), and centered text. Remove default spinner arrows if possible.

Create a small notification icon container (.notification-icon) with a background color (#007bff) and white text (#fff). It should be circular (e.g., 20px by 20px, border-radius: 50%) and display a number (font-size: 0.7em, text-align: center).

Style a breadcrumb item (.breadcrumb-item) with dark gray text (#6c757d) and a small right arrow (e.g., ' > ') as a separator after it. The last item in the breadcrumb should be bold and primary blue (#007bff).
Style a basic link (.basic-link) with a primary blue color (#007bff), an underline on hover, and no underline by default.

Style a single line of code within a block (.code-line) with a monospace font (font-family: 'Courier New', monospace), a dark background (#222), light gray text (#eee), and 2px left padding. Add a specific line number element (.line-num, color: #888, width: 20px, display: inline-block).

Style an event time slot (.time-slot) with a light blue background (#e0f7fa), dark blue text (#007bff), 8px padding, and a light blue border (1px solid #b2ebf2). On hover, the background should darken slightly.

Style the author information for a testimonial. It should have the author's name (.author-name, font-weight: bold, color: #333) and their title/company (.author-title, font-size: 0.85em, color: #6c757d) below it. Add 10px top margin.

Display an old price (.old-price) struck through with a light gray color (#999), next to a new price (.new-price) in a prominent red color (#dc3545) with bold text. Add 5px right margin to the old price.
Style a single rating star (.rating-star) as a yellow asterisk (e.g., '⭐' or '★') with a font size of 1.2em. Active stars should be yellow (#ffc107) and inactive stars should be light gray (#e9ecef).
Style a heading for a dashboard card (.dashboard-heading) with a font size of 1.3em, bold text, and a dark gray color (#343a40). Add a 10px bottom margin.

Design a small square social media icon (.social-icon) with a fixed size (30px by 30px), a primary brand color background (e.g., blue for Twitter #1da1f2, red for YouTube #ff0000), and white text/icon. Add a small border-radius (4px).
Style a product description paragraph (.product-description) with a dark gray color (#444), a font size of 0.95em, and a line-height of 1.6.
Style a small text link (.small-link) with a blue color (#007bff), a font size of 0.8em, and no underline by default. Underline on hover.
Style a label for a checkbox (.checkbox-label) with dark gray text (#333) and a slight left margin (5px) to separate it from the checkbox input.

Design an informational button (.info-button) with a light blue background (#17a2b8), white text (#fff), 8px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, and rounded corners (border-radius: 4px). On hover, darken the background slightly.
Style an article date (.article-date) with a light gray color (#6c757d), a small font size (0.8em), and an italic font style.
Style a success message text (.success-text) with a green color (#28a745), bold text, and a small top margin (10px).
Style placeholder text for an input field (.input-placeholder) with a light gray color (#aaa) and a slightly italic font style.
Style an image caption (.image-caption) with a small font size (0.8em), a light gray color (#6c757d), and centered text. Add 5px top margin.

Design an interactive grid item (.grid-item) with a light gray background (#f8f8f8), a subtle border (1px solid #eee), 10px padding, and a hover effect that slightly changes the background color (#f0f0f0).
Style a header navigation link (.header-nav-link) with dark text (#333), 10px horizontal padding, and a border-bottom (2px solid transparent) that turns blue (#007bff) on hover.
Create a small, round button (.round-btn) with a dark gray background (#6c757d), white text (#fff), 10px padding, and a border-radius of 50%. On hover, darken the background slightly.
Style a feature list item in a pricing table (.pricing-feature) with dark text (#333), 5px bottom margin, and a green checkmark icon (or similar) on the left if it's included.

Style an input field (.form-input.error) with a red border (1px solid #dc3545) and a light red background (#fff0f0) to indicate an error. Add a small error message (.error-message, color: #dc3545, font-size: 0.8em) below it.
Style a section title (.section-title) with a large font size (2.2em), bold text, dark gray color (#333), and centered alignment. Add 20px top and 15px bottom margin.

Combine a small round avatar (.avatar) (40px by 40px, border-radius: 50%, 1px solid #ccc) with a small green status dot (.status-indicator) (8px by 8px, #28a745) positioned at the bottom right corner of the avatar.

Create a `div` with class `card-container` containing a `h3` with class `card-title` and a `p` with class `card-content`. The container should have a light grey background (#f8f8f8), a 1px solid light grey border (#ddd), 15px padding, and a max-width of 300px. The title should be dark grey (#333), 1.2em font-size. The content should be slightly lighter grey (#666), 0.9em font-size.

Design a `div` with class `highlight-block` containing a `span` with class `highlight-text`. The block should have a subtle yellow background (#fffacd), 10px padding, and a 1px dashed orange border (#ffa500). The text within the span should be bold, orange (#ffa500), and 1.1em font-size.

Create an `li` with class `icon-list-item`. Inside, there's an `i` with class `list-icon` and a `span` with class `list-text`. The list item should have 5px vertical padding. The icon should be blue (#007bff), 1.2em font-size, and have 8px right margin. The text should be dark grey (#333).

Style a `button` with class `subtle-cta`. It should have a light blue background (#e0f7fa), dark blue text (#007bff), 10px vertical and 20px horizontal padding, no border, and a subtle border-radius of 4px. On hover, the background should darken slightly (#b2ebf2).

Design a `div` with class `banner-message` containing a `p` with class `banner-text` and a `span` with class `banner-close`. The banner should have a light green background (#d4edda), a 1px solid green border (#28a745), 12px padding, and green text (#155724). The close span should be bold, slightly larger, and positioned to the right.
Style an `img` with class `avatar-round`. It should be 50px by 50px, have a border-radius of 50%, and a 2px solid light grey border (#ccc).

Create a `div` with class `feature-box`. Inside, there's a `h4` with class `feature-title` and a `p` with class `feature-description`. The box should have a white background, 15px padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#eee), and a subtle box-shadow. The title should be a medium grey (#444), 1.1em font-size. The description should be a lighter grey (#777).
Design a `span` with class `tag-badge`. It should have a light blue background (#e9ecef), dark grey text (#495057), 5px vertical and 10px horizontal padding, and a border-radius of 15px.

Style an `a` tag with class `category-link`. It should have a light purple background (#f3e5f5), dark purple text (#673ab7), 4px vertical and 8px horizontal padding, no underline, and a subtle border-radius of 3px. On hover, the background should darken slightly (#e1bee7).

Create a `div` with class `stat-card`. Inside, a `p` with class `stat-label` and a `span` with class `stat-value`. The card should have a white background, 20px padding, a 1px solid very light grey border (#f0f0f0), and a light box-shadow. The label should be light grey (#888), 0.8em font-size. The value should be large (2em), bold, and dark blue (#007bff).

Style an `li` with class `ingredient-item`. It contains a `span` with class `ingredient-qty` and a `span` with class `ingredient-name`. The list item should have 8px bottom margin. The quantity should be bold, dark grey (#333), and have 8px right margin. The name should be regular grey (#555).

Design a `span` with class `notification-bubble`. It should be 20px by 20px, have a red background (#dc3545), white text, a border-radius of 50%, display as `inline-block`, and be centered vertically and horizontally within its own space.

Style an `a` tag with class `action-link`. It contains an `i` with class `link-icon` and a `span` with class `link-text`. The link should be dark blue (#007bff), no underline. The icon should have 5px right margin. On hover, the text should be underlined.

Create a `h4` with class `form-section-header`. It should have a light grey background (#f2f2f2), 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#ddd) at the bottom, and dark grey text (#333).

Design a `div` with class `success-box`. It contains an `i` with class `success-icon` and a `p` with class `success-message`. The box should have a light green background (#d4edda), a 1px solid green border (#28a745), 15px padding, and green text (#155724). The icon should have 10px right margin.

Style a `div` with class `contact-item`. It contains a `span` with class `contact-label` and a `span` with class `contact-value`. The item should have 8px vertical padding. The label should be bold, dark grey (#333). The value should be regular grey (#555).
Style an `img` with class `thumbnail-border`. It should be 100px by 100px, have a 2px solid light blue border (#add8e6), and a 5px padding inside the border.

Create an `li` with class `feature-check`. It contains an `i` with class `check-icon` and a `span` with class `feature-text`. The list item should have 5px vertical padding. The icon should be green (#28a745) and have 8px right margin. The text should be dark grey (#333).
Style an `a` tag with class `search-title`. It should be dark blue (#007bff), 1.2em font-size, and underlined on hover. It should have 5px bottom margin.

Design a `span` with class `step-number`. It should be 25px by 25px, have a dark grey background (#333), white text, a border-radius of 50%, display as `inline-flex`, and be centered vertically and horizontally. It should have 10px right margin.

Create a `div` with class `progress-bar-container` and an inner `div` with class `progress-bar-fill`. The container should have a light grey background (#e0e0e0), 8px height, and a border-radius of 4px. The fill should have a blue background (#007bff) and extend 60% of the width, with the same height and border-radius.

Style a `p` with class `profile-bio`. It should have a light grey background (#f5f5f5), 15px padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#eee), and slightly smaller font-size (0.95em) with dark grey text (#444).
Design a `span` with class `event-location`. It should be light grey (#777), 0.9em font-size, and have an `i` with class `location-icon` prepended. The icon should be 5px right margin.
Create a `span` with class `discount-label`. It should have a red background (#dc3545), white text, 8px vertical and 12px horizontal padding, and a border-radius of 4px. Font size 0.85em.

Style a `button` with class `modal-footer-btn`. It should have a light grey background (#f0f0f0), dark grey text (#333), 8px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), and a border-radius of 4px. On hover, background should slightly darken (#e0e0e0).
Design a `hr` with class `section-divider`. It should have a 1px solid very light grey border (#eee), 20px vertical margin, and no default browser styling.

Create a `span` with class `status-indicator`. It should be 10px by 10px, have a green background (#28a745), a border-radius of 50%, display as `inline-block`, and have 5px right margin. For an 'incomplete' status, the background should be orange (#ffc107).

Style an `a` tag with class `download-btn`. The icon should have 8px right margin. On hover, the background should darken slightly (#218838).

Design a `span` with class `quantity-display`. It should have a light grey background (#f8f8f8), 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#ddd), and dark grey text (#333). It should be `inline-block`.
Style an `h2` with class `post-title`. It should be dark grey (#333), 1.5em font-size, and have 10px bottom margin. On hover, the text should be underlined.

Create an `a` tag with class `social-link`. It contains an `i` with class `social-icon`. The link should be 30px by 30px, display `inline-flex`, be centered, have a light grey background (#eee), dark grey text (#555), a border-radius of 50%, and 8px right margin. On hover, the background should be dark blue (#007bff) and text white.

Style an `li` with class `key-feature`. It contains a `span` with class `feature-name` and a `span` with class `feature-value`. The list item should have 6px vertical padding. The name should be bold, dark grey (#333), and have 10px right margin. The value should be light grey (#666).

Design a `div` with class `warning-alert`. It contains an `i` with class `alert-icon` and a `p` with class `alert-message`. The box should have a light yellow background (#fff3cd), a 1px solid orange border (#ffc107), 15px padding, and orange text (#856404). The icon should have 10px right margin.
Style an `img` with class `product-frame`. It should be 150px by 150px, have a 5px solid white border, and a 1px solid light grey border (#ddd) outside the white border.
Style a `td` with class `table-data`. It should have 10px padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#eee), and dark grey text (#444).

Create a `span` with class `role-tag`. It should have a light purple background (#e6e6fa), dark purple text (#800080), 4px vertical and 8px horizontal padding, and a border-radius of 10px. Font size 0.8em.
Style a `span` with class `author-name`. It should be dark grey (#333), bold, and have 5px right margin. It should be an `a` tag or similar that underlines on hover.

Create a `button` with class `filter-btn`. It should have a light blue background (#add8e6), dark blue text (#007bff), 8px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, no border, and a border-radius of 4px. On hover, the background should darken slightly (#87ceeb).

Design a `div` with class `countdown-timer`. It contains a `span` with class `timer-value` and a `span` with class `timer-unit`. Style a `span` with class `currency-price`. It contains a `span` with class `currency-symbol` and a `span` with class `price-value`. The symbol should be grey (#777), 0.9em font-size. The value should be dark grey (#333), bold, and 1.3em font-size.

Create a `div` with class `modal-overlay`. It should cover the entire viewport (fixed position, top 0, left 0, width 100%, height 100%), have a semi-transparent black background (#00000080), and be positioned on top of other content (z-index 1000).

Style an `a` tag with class `pagination-item`. It should have 8px vertical and 12px horizontal padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#ddd), and dark grey text (#333). Design a `span` with class `review-count`. It should be light grey (#888), 0.9em font-size, and enclosed in parentheses. It should have 5px left margin.
Create a `span` with class `metric-label`. It should be bold, dark grey (#333), and have 8px bottom margin. It should be displayed as a block.
Style a `p` with class `article-excerpt`. It should be light grey (#666), 0.95em font-size, and have 15px bottom margin.

Style an `input` with type 'text' and class `search-input`. It should have 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), a border-radius of 4px, and a placeholder text color of light grey (#999).

Create a `div` with class `comparison-item`. It contains a `h4` with class `item-name` and a `ul` with class `item-features`.
